messages:
Maya R: Quick heads up  we locked the April 12 webinar slot. Want to run a tight social push the week prior: mix of nano/micro X seeding + LinkedIn advocates. Thoughts on cadence?

Owen L: Love it. Proposed cadence: teaser 4 days out -> short demo clip 2 days out -> registration nudge day-of. Keep posts <2 lines on X and a slightly longer LinkedIn post. :calendar:

Priya S: For boostsdo we fund all or split paid/organic? I've got a $2k flex budget if needed.

Maya R: Split. Prioritize 3 paid X boosts (highest reach handles), rest organic asks. Priya, can you confirm allocation by EOD?

Devon (Content): Ill make: 15s vertical teaser, 20-30s demo clip (square), single-page asset with 3 CTA variants, and 3 caption styles (bite, story, metric). Need final UTM params.

Maya R: Deadline for assets: Wed COB. Drop Figma links here when ready.

Devon (Content): Filed drafts: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/Webinar-Apr12-Assets

Kai (Ops): scheduling note: crossposting + approvals need 48h minimum. schedule-bot will enforce.

schedule-bot: Reminder: Campaign posts require 48-hour lead time for approvals and crossposting.

Owen L: Rough posting plan:
```
Mon 4/8 9:30am X teaser (organic seeds)
Tue 4/9 10:30am LinkedIn advocates (initial)
Wed 4/10 9:00am X demo clip (paid boosts x3)
Thu 4/11 11:00am LinkedIn reminder + assets
Fri 4/12 8:30am X registration push + live reminders
```

Priya S: Budget split proposed: $800 top booster, $600 second, $400 third, $200 holdback. I'll execute and upload receipts.

Maya R: Sounds good. Also want a micro A/B on CTA language across paid boosts: "Reserve your spot" vs "Save my seat". Track which converts better.

Devon (Content): I'll prepare caption variants and include placeholder overlay: "XX% latency reduction" pending eng confirmation.

Priya S: Ill confirm with Eng-ML on the stat. Tagging them now.

Owen L: Monitoring plan: assign 2 people to cover replies and DMs during 1h pre/post each push. Who can own?

Kai (Ops): I can cover ops monitoring windows. Need DM templates for quick replies.

Devon (Content): DM templates drafted: https://docs.google.com/document/d/abc123 (comment access). Three short replies: thanks + link; reminder + quick win; speaker highlight + register.

Maya R: Great. Advocates list  aim for 4 partners, 2 customers, 2 internal leads. Owen, can you compile and DM asks?

Owen L: On it. Will also brief advocates to comment within 24h to boost visibility.

Priya S: Confirmed budget execution timeline: run boosts Wed morning. Will add UTM: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=apr12_webinar&utm_content={variant}

Maya R: Final action items:
- Devon: assets + captions + figma by Wed COB
- Owen: advocates list + outreach templates by Thu AM
- Priya: run boosts + receipts by Thu EOD
- Kai: monitoring rota + post templates by Thu EOD

Owen L: I'll also post a quick tracker in #marketing-campaigns with who posted + engagement numbers after the push.

Maya R: OK locking this plan unless anyone raises concerns by EOD. Thanks team :raised_hands:
